answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network enforces game-theoretic multi-agent auditing using topological cut verifications. Honest nodes audit suspect clusters: if a partitioned clique's boundary forms an unverified bottleneck cut, their staked tokens are slashed. Colluding clusters face superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(k^2) relative to size k. Dishonest validators find no ivory tower to hide in, their plume of fake identities evaporates, and faulty proofs push them off the economic ledge.
